title: Seems defective - never used
text: Seems defective - never used. Product came with plastic wrapper which appeared to have melted to the product leaving a sticky residue on it. Also, inside both lids there is a plastic piece with the rubber seal. This was loose and rattling around, which seemed like the lids would not provide a tight seal. I read both positive and negative reviews of this product before I purchases and took a risk. Sadly, this product went back into the back within 5 min of opening and I processed my return. Never even tried the product as the lids appeared to be defective and I didn't want to take another risk and have something leak all over creating a giant mess. Do not buy this product.

product_metadata.title: Portable Blender, G-TING Personal Smoothies Blender Cordless, Single Serve Mini Blender 450ml USB Rechargeable Small Juice Mixer Portable Juicer (Shakes, Smoothies, Home, Travel & Gym) Food Grade
features: √[Professional blender with display screen]: This portable blender is made of BPA free material, food grade stainless steel blades and has a display screen. High quality material makes this personal blender suitable for making smoothies, juices, shakes, baby food and so on. And the display screen will tell you the status of blender( fully charged, low battery, improper installation, etc.)

√[Upgrade safety design]: A lot of customers afraid the blender will accidentally turn on while cleaning the blades. So we improve our new portable blender. Unlike other blenders, our blender can not be turned on when you remove the blender cup from the base. No more safety concern when you are cleaning the blades.

√[ USB rechargeable]: This portable USB rechargeable blender equipped with 3000mAh rechargeable built-in battery which can be fully charged within 2-5 hours. The blender can produce 15-20 cups of juice when it is fully charged. You can charge it with different power source, like your phone charger,power bank, laptop and so on.

√[Strong and Powerful]: Equipped with powerful motor and sharp stainless steel six blades, the no load rotating speed can reach 16500 rpm±15%. By using such powerful personal blender, your favorite drinks like smoothies and shakes will be ready within 40 seconds.

√[Portable design]: Comes with a travel lid, by removing the blender base, the personal blender can easily become a portable blender bottle. You can drink nutritious juice, shakes or smoothies anywhere you want, such as home, office, gym, travel or any other outdoor activities.
